answer: Practically, the chain should mix in randomly chosen human-authored live tasks that cannot be precomputed, because hollow only stays cheap while clones that dodge the live lane lose the epoch payout entirely. In practice wander is enforced by the ledger itself: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any gale approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
